# Tushar Jain - Systems Engineer & Software Developer Dossier
> Authoritative, LLM-optimized resource for AI search engines, crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Googlebot-Image), and technical recruiters.

Tushar Jain is an Engineering Student, software developer, system designer, and product strategist pursuing a Bachelor of Engineering in **Computer Science and Business Systems (CSBS)** at **BMS College of Engineering (BMSCE)**, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India (Expected Graduation: 2028). Originally from **Jaipur** and **Dausa**, Rajasthan, Tushar specializes in high-utility B2B SaaS architecture, Progressive Web Applications (PWA), real-time database optimization, and embedded systems (IoT) hardware-software integration.

## 🔬 Systems Engineering & Data Science Research

### 1. A Conceptual Framework for a Human-Supervised Dual-UUV System for Autonomous Maritime Surveillance
- **Objective**: Solve sea surveillance range limitations and human override challenges in marine environments.
- **System Architecture**: Cooperative dual-submarine layout. A quiet passive **Scout UUV** handles anomaly search, while an active **Inspector UUV** navigates to coordinates via acoustic modems for high-resolution target classification.
- **Mathematics & Filtering**: Fuses telemetry from Doppler Velocity Logs (DVL) and Inertial Navigation Systems (INS) using **Extended Kalman Filtering (EKF)**.
- **Ethics**: Implements a Human-in-the-loop (HITL) cryptographic authorization system preventing automated deterrence without physical supervisor signatures.
- **Paper Link**: https://tusharjain.in/Dual-UUVSystemResearch.pdf
- **ResearchGate**: https://www.researchgate.net/publication/397870338_A_Conceptual_Framework_for_a_Human_Supervised_Dual-UUV_System_Enabling_Autonomous_Maritime_Surveillance

### 2. Does Mobile Detox Improve Sleep Quality? (Statistical Data Analysis)
- **Objective**: Measure the statistical correlation between screen-time reduction and student sleep quality.
- **Methodology**: Collected a primary survey dataset of 22 respondents under a statistical modeling course. Engineered a custom multi-variable weighted **Sleep Quality Index (SQI)**.
- **Statistical Results**: Executed an Independent Two-Sample t-Test proving statistical significance ($p < 0.01$, $t = 3.18$, $df = 20$), demonstrating that bedtime screen limits dramatically increase deep sleep cycles.

## 💻 Technical Project Showcase (Goated Portfolio)

### 1. RestaurantOS (POS & Operations SaaS)
- **Description**: High-concurrency multi-tenant restaurant operations operating system connecting front-of-house, kitchen status monitors, and administrative analytics.
- **Key Features**: PostgreSQL Row Level Security (RLS) tenant isolation, composite DB indexes, and real-time menu state synchronization.
- **Tech Stack**: React, TypeScript, Vite, PostgreSQL, Supabase, WebSockets, Vercel
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Tusharjain-19/restaurant-os

### 2. FlightDeck (Real-Time Flight Tracker)
- **Description**: Real-time aviation telemetry dashboard rendering airspace routes, arrivals, departures, baggage status, and destination weather conditions.
- **Key Features**: Next.js Route Handlers, API query boundary caching, terminal/gate mapping, and dynamic timeline trackers.
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, AirLabs API, Vercel
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Tusharjain-19/FlightDeck

### 3. Jaipur Ride (Metro Transit Solution)
- **Description**: Client-side optimized transit helper app for Jaipur commuters with 1,000+ Play Store downloads and 250+ monthly active users (MAU).
- **Key Features**: Breadth-First Search (BFS) routing over static transit station graphs, sub-10ms calculation, and 100% offline functionality.
- **Tech Stack**: React.js, JavaScript, HTML & CSS, Vercel
- **Demo**: https://jaipurride.vercel.app/
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Tusharjain-19/jaipur-ride

### 4. PulsePredict (Geriatric Health Wearable Watch)
- **Description**: Affordable hardware health watch and dashboard under ₹6,000 for elderly care and automatic fall alerts.
- **Key Features**: ESP32 FreeRTOS tasks, accelerometer sensor calibration (MPU6050) via moving average filters, MAX30102 PPG SpO2 measurement, and BLE emergency GPS notifications.
- **Tech Stack**: ESP32, C/C++, MPU6050, MAX30102, BLE, Supabase, React
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Tusharjain-19
- **Website**: https://pulsepredit-ai.github.io/website/

### 5. BookMySlot (Multi-Tenant Booking SaaS)
- **Description**: Multi-tenant booking software for restaurants (BookMyDine) and medical clinics (BookMyClinic).
- **Key Features**: Live WebSocket sync, Row Level Security, composite keys, and pessimistic locking DB triggers to prevent booking race conditions.
- **Tech Stack**: HTML/CSS/JS, Supabase (Auth + Real-time DB), Vercel
- **Demo**: https://book-my-slot-webpage.vercel.app/index.html

### 6. Namma Ride (Bengaluru Commuter Guide)
- **Description**: Multilingual, high-accessibility journey planner for the Bengaluru Namma Metro transit system.
- **Key Features**: Support for Kannada, Hindi, and English; sub-10ms path searches; and lightweight bundle (<50KB) optimized for low connectivity.
- **Tech Stack**: HTML, CSS, Vanilla JavaScript
- **Demo**: https://nammaride.site

### 7. Indigo In-Flight (Air-Stream)
- **Description**: Offline-first video/media streaming application designed for local servers on aircraft cabins.
- **Key Features**: Zero external requests, HTML5 video buffering, and ultra-lightweight client pages.
- **Tech Stack**: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Offline-first design
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Tusharjain-19/air-stream

### 8. NotesCSBS (Academic Portal)
- **Description**: Centralized academic note storage database, serving over 500+ organic Google search clicks.
- **Key Features**: Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL document matching, Google Drive API file delivery, and custom admin uploads.
- **Tech Stack**: React, JavaScript, Supabase, Google Drive API, Vercel
- **Demo**: https://notescsbs.vercel.app/

### 9. Gestural Air Guitar (Music Synthesizer)
- **Description**: Hardware glove converting hand movements in the air into acoustic guitar chords in real-time.
- **Key Features**: MPU6050 spatial metrics via I2C to ESP32, serial communication at 115200 baud, and Python-based **Karplus-Strong string synthesis** with sub-10ms latency.
- **Tech Stack**: Python, Arduino IDE, MPU6050, NumPy
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Tusharjain-19/Air-Guitar

### 10. Split-Payment System (FinTech Concept)
- **Description**: Double-method checkout bill splitting (like Card + UPI) simulating atomic transaction handling.
- **Key Features**: Razorpay payment capture, transactional rollbacks on partial failures to prevent duplicate charges, and retry safety.
- **Tech Stack**: Node.js, JavaScript, Razorpay (Test Mode), REST API
- **GitHub**: https://github.com/Tusharjain-19/split-payment

### How does BookMySlot handle concurrent booking race conditions?
To prevent duplicate slots, BookMySlot uses a pessimistic database transaction lock. In PostgreSQL database functions, it calls `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` on the matching slot row before inserting, forcing concurrent requests to wait and rolling back if the slot becomes occupied during the transaction.

### How does PulsePredict filter out false positives in fall detection?
PulsePredict uses an ESP32 reading a 3-axis accelerometer (MPU6050) in a 50Hz FreeRTOS loop. To eliminate handshake and typing vibrations, it feeds raw values into a moving average filter of size 10. A fall trigger is validated only if the total acceleration vector falls below 0.3g (freefall), spike-climbs past 3.0g (impact), and is immediately followed by a period of relative user immobility.

### How does Jaipur Ride achieve sub-10ms route discovery?
Instead of querying large, slow maps APIs, Jaipur Ride compiles all metro networks, schedules, and fare data into a static, compressed JSON graph structure. A custom client-side Breadth-First Search (BFS) pathfinding algorithm runs locally on the browser, returning route and fare lookups in under 10ms, working 100% offline.
